reviews.text:
We lived through one of the hardest moments of our lives when our sweet Ember began having nonstop seizures. At VEG, Dr. Key, Vet Nurse Nicole, and the team moved with urgency and compassion. They explained everything clearly, gave us time to breathe, and supported us through every decision.

When Ember’s seizures returned, Dr. Fowler came aboard and Vet Nurse Nicole was there again—gentle, honest, and deeply caring. We hoped the medications would give her relief, and for a short time they did. But on the third day, when the seizures came back, we knew we couldn’t let her suffer.

Dr. Fowler and Vet Nurse Leslie cared for Ember and all 7 of us humans—with extraordinary tenderness. They gave us a quiet room, unlimited time, and even a Bark‑uterie board just for Ember. Vet Nurse Leslie translated each step for our family members who didn’t speak English, making sure everyone understood and felt included. When Ember passed, they stayed with us in kindness and patience, giving us all the time we needed to say goodbye.

We hope we never need an ER again, but knowing VEG is filled with people who give the best care, we will always return if we must.

VEG ER for Pets provides excellent emergency veterinary care. I have had to visit their clinic twice for each of my doodles (Goldendoodle and Bernedoodle). Throughout each visit, the staff has been remarkably compassionate, empathetic, and attentive. Emergency vet trips are inherently stressful; however, this team consistently mitigates that anxiety through calm, professional communication and genuine care. They listen closely to concerns and explain their treatment plans clearly. It is a tremendous relief to have such a dependable, capable team available for urgent situations.

My experience at VEG Veterinarians was superb!!

A friendly and helpful staff all the way through - with good and seemingly wise advice.

And the price wasn't too bad either!!

Thanks again,

Tom Prejean

Dr. Nealy and the entire team were incredible. They treated us with consideration and kept me and my dog as comfortable as possible. They took us to a treatment room after I explained my dog was reactive and they were attentive to us and our concerns. Extremely grateful to them.

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We hope Clover is feeling better. We are here to help if you ever need urgent or emergent are in the future. 

Tiane DeVore, DVM
Medical Director-VEG Dallas
The whole staff was very warm and supportive during the loss of our family dog.  It means a lot to us in this difficult time.

We arrived with a 3 month old Yorkie puppy whose rectum has prolapsed.  They examined her and said she needed surgery but wouldn’t touch her after that until we could show that we had the ability to pay.  I guess that’s normal procedure but it was disappointing and did slow things down quite a bit.  She did eventually have the surgery and things appear to be going well so far.

Our first time to VEG on Knox/Henderson. Brought in our 13 year old Chihuahua after a very sad diagnosis earlier in the day from one of the Vet's at our primary vet, where we were pretty much told there is nothing that could be done and to prepare for euthanasia.

Contrast this to the experience we have at VEG that evening. Immediately brought back to an exam table and our dog was cared for by an amazing staff. We were amazed at this place: it's kind of like 'The Pitt' but for pets. Amazing work culture: you can tell everyone that works there are very passionate about what they do, extremely competent, and also really enjoy working with each other.

We have more time with our dog because of this place. We'll never go anywhere else for ER for pets going forward.

This place is just amazing. The response time to our emergency was instantaneous and the love and care of the whole whole staff really helped us through our extremely difficult time. Thank you to the whole staff!
Hi Daniel, thank you for your 5-star rating!

It’s always scary when you have to take your pet to the ER, but each few times over the years with  a couple pets, its always the same. The team and doctors there are so attentive and caring. I trust them with my babies every time.

I cannot say enough good things about the VEG team and the life-saving treatment they gave my dog, Toby.

Toby came in in critical condition, and from the moment we arrived, the team treated his condition with urgency, compassion, and incredible care. They immediately began testing and providing the treatments he needed.

Dr. Becker and Molly were amazing. They made sure Toby was cared for while also keeping me informed throughout the entire process about what was being administered and why. I never felt like I was in the dark. Being able to stay right there with Toby and actually see the care he was receiving gave me so much reassurance during an incredibly scary situation.

I also felt like I could advocate for Toby when I needed to. I was never judged, dismissed, or criticized for asking questions or speaking up on his behalf. Everyone was incredibly receptive and respectful.

Angelina, his overnight nurse, and the overnight doctor were wonderful as well.

What also stood out to me was the compassion from people who weren’t even directly involved in Toby’s treatment. Team members noticed when I was upset and would bring me Kleenex, check on me, and make sure I was okay.

At one point, Toby was extremely agitated, and I realized that holding him and rocking him was helping calm him down. I was sitting in a folding chair doing this when one of the nurses noticed. She asked how long I planned to stay, and I told her probably a couple more hours if that was okay. She immediately offered to find me something more comfortable and came back with a big upholstered chair with arms from the lobby so I could sit comfortably and hold him.

That may sound like a small thing, but in that moment it meant so much. I ended up sitting there for hours holding Toby and rocking him until he finally calmed down and fell asleep.

I noticed VEG’s values and mission posted outside the treatment area, and after spending so many hours there, I can honestly say that this team lives those values. Not every company can say that.

Every single person I encountered was responsive, caring, empathetic, and compassionate — not only toward Toby, but toward me during one of the scariest experiences I have ever had with him.

Toby is alive today because of the care he received at VEG, and I will forever be grateful to this team.

We came in without calling first as our dog was extremely ill. We received quick care, and the team made sure Winnie was as comfortable as she could be the whole time and was able to stay in my lap for most of the visit. It was very clear how much the team cares about your pets and your experience.

this is a completely different experience from other ER they let us stay and go in with our pet, everyone was very kind and you can tell they care. we came back home changing the number one number to call for our furry babies.
thanks to all the staff even the ones we did not interact with , we saw you and can tell you care.

Brought a friend to the clinic last night with her cat who had just had a seizure.  All the staff members, especially the vet whose name I didn’t catch, were so nice and comforting.  I know where I’ll be bringing my own pets for emergency care in the future!

Hi Vester, thank you for your positive rating! 

Tiane DeVore, DVM
Medical Director-VEG Dallas

They are the most expensive in the metroplex and their pricing structure is very much dependent ton whom you deal with. There are other similar businesses I’d rather go to for my future needs with my pet

VEG staff is very nice and they have deal with such sad things all day.  I have taken all 3 of my dogs here for emergencies… pleasant experience and provides several options but ultimately let’s you make the best decision for you and your pet.
This place is the best. They provided wonderful care to our dog latte when she needed it the most. We highly recommend VEG for their excellent staff and attitudes during hard times. Thank you!

My dog ate some dark chocolate and I was hysterical. The staff was amazing I forgot my vet techs name but her and Doctor Huffman were incredible and so reassuring. My dog is happy and healthy and I am forever grateful!! If you need a vet emergency room this is where you need to go!

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We hope Dolly is recovering well from her recent ER visit. Please let us know if you need anything.

Tiane DeVore, DVM
Medical Director-VEG Dallas

Everyone from the moment we got there were attentive, kind and super supportive of our cat Charlie. They did everything to make both Charlie and us feel super comfortable. All the doctors we saw were empathetic and explained to us every procedure and walked us through the entire process. They were super thorough in his history gathering and treatment process, even going so far as to give us blankets to stay warm as we were there for a prolonged period of time. We are super grateful they were able to treat our son and get him feeling good again.

I am so bad with names, but everyone on the night shift crew and morning shift crew were super kind and fantastic to us! Dr. Nealy (I'm sorry if I misspelled it) was, I believe, one the doctors who did the procedure on Charlie. For her we are ever grateful she was able to help Charlie feel better.

We came here over the holiday weekend with our pup. We showed up after 1am, and the staff still could not have been more attentive, friendly, and helpful. Dr. Huffman and her team turned a potentially horrible situation for my family into one of relief.

We certainly hope to never need to return, but should an emergency arise, we will absolutely be coming back to VEG.

I cannot express how grateful I am to this incredible team for the care they provided to Salomon during one of the most frightening and vulnerable moments of our lives.

We visited the ER twice. During our first visit, Dr. Huffman and Celeste were beyond helpful, compassionate, and loving toward both Salomon and our family. Although we arrived with no clear understanding of what was wrong, they did everything they could to help us, make us comfortable, and provide support.

Our second visit was an emotional roller coaster. We arrived around 10 a.m. genuinely believing we might lose Salomon and remained there until approximately 7 p.m. Dr. Crocker was absolutely extraordinary. She was incredibly thorough, strategic, and diligent. Instead of immediately putting Salomon through countless unfocused tests, she carefully evaluated his condition, knew exactly where to begin, and kept us informed and calm throughout the entire process.

Dr. Crocker ultimately discovered that Salomon has an autoimmune disease and ensured that he received the treatment he desperately needed. After only two days on medication, he began returning to his normal self. I truly believe that Salomon is alive today because of Dr. Crocker. Her knowledge, persistence, attention to detail, and compassion saved his life. There are no words sufficient to express what she did for our family, and we will be forever grateful to her.

It was not only Dr. Crocker’s intelligence and remarkable clinical judgment that allowed her to determine exactly what was wrong with Salomon, but also her extraordinary compassion and humanity. She was so kind, gentle, and caring, and she made us feel that we were never alone throughout such a terrifying experience.

I also want to recognize Celia at reception. She was incredibly kind, thoughtful, and supportive. She communicated with such compassion, gave us blankets, and made sure that Salomon and our family felt cared for throughout an extremely difficult day.

The entire staff was amazing, but I especially want to thank Dr. Crocker, Dr. Huffman, Celeste, and Celia. This team did not simply provide excellent medical care they treated us with genuine humanity and love when we needed it most. I would recommend this ER without hesitation.

He was sick for several days under the care of other doctors without a real solution. Until we arrived at VEG ER, and their attention was very quick, their explanations were excellent, and they kept us informed every step of the way. So if you're looking for a place where they can heal your friend and take care of them, this is it. ❤️‍🩹
The care of everyone who works there and Dr. Wilton's love and commitment saved my baby! 💙 We are incredibly grateful to have Bruno home. He is recovering very quickly from his surgery. 🥹 Thank you for everything!!

This location was unbelievably clean, organized and the staff was truly interested in the health and wellbeing  of our dog, Larry

The equipment was state of the art - I felt as if were in a ER for people … I  was very impressed.
Staff was very sweet and immediately took great care of our labradoodle when we believed she chewed up an empty can of sardines. Thank you for your urgency and care.
awesome people exceptional talents, we are so grateful for three young vets and vet techs for saving my baby's life. Lexee is doing wonderful and back to her normal self right away . Thank you.

With all my heart, I thank you for saving my dog ​​Camila's life, thanks to these wonderful people. Words fail me; I am so grateful. Thank you so much, and may God watch over you and bless you always. I will always be more than grateful.
Such an incredible staff. Could not have asked for better people helping our dog get nursed back to health.

I had a great experience here! They got us seen almost immediately, and everyone was so helpful, professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. They took great care of my cat and gave him shots to help with his symptoms. He’s already acting like himself again. He’s eating and drinking, watching the window, cuddling, and no longer isolating himself. He’s still drooling a tiny bit, but overall he’s doing SO much better. I’m very grateful for how kind and reassuring everyone was during such a stressful situation. Highly recommend! ❤️

I cannot say enough wonderful things about VEG Dallas. My dog, Gertie, was transferred to VEG after being diagnosed with IMHA at DUAC, and what was an incredibly scary and emotional time was made so much easier by the kindness and compassion of their entire team.

Gertie needed to be hospitalized overnight, and Kody went above and beyond by setting me up in a room with a cot so I could sleep there with her. Being able to stay by her side the entire time brought me so much comfort, and I know it brought Gertie comfort too. I will never forget that kindness.

Every single person we encountered cared for her so genuinely…from the CSR who helped me carry Gertie into the clinic, to the veterinary technicians, to the doctors overseeing her care. Everyone was gentle, compassionate, and so sweet to her. I never felt like she was just another patient.

When Gertie ultimately needed specialty care, they helped facilitate her transfer to VCA and made sure she was getting the next level of care she needed.

Having a critically ill pet is terrifying, but VEG made us feel cared for every step of the way. I’m incredibly grateful to the entire team for taking such wonderful care of my girl…and for taking care of me, too. 💗
The staff were prompt, kind, and highly knowledgeable in caring for our kitty. Our physician and nurse, Dr. Spurlin and Tosha were fantastic.

They have great people working there.
They are professional and compassionate.

I hate to say I enjoyed my experience because my cat was sick and I was stressed and worried, but it was as good an experience as I could have hoped for. The staff showed extreme care for my cat and were very patient and responsive to me with my questions. Of course it is expensive to utilize an emergency vet but in this case I felt it was worth it knowing my cat was well cared for. I appreciate being able to stay with her during testing and observation. Bottom line she felt better on discharge and that made me happy.
I wish I could remember the names of the folks who helped care for my kitty but I can't. However everyone who helped, from the vet techs to the doctors, was great. I would definitely trust my cat's care to them again.

Back again, but this time for our cat.  We chose to drive an hour here because we completely trust their care and expertise.  Our cat had a serious illness and they were honest and up front about everything.  Good news...he's doing well!  I can't thank the entire "Orangey" cat team enough for their communication, attentiveness, love, thoughtfulness, thoroughness for a complete diagnosis, and all-around care.  From the moment we walked in and were greeted to the time we left and every phone call and follow-up, we THANK YOU!

Dr. Watson, Dr. Huffman and Sarah Brown helped me. Every single person who spoke to us, helped us, asked if we needed anything, brought our dog a blanket, treated our dog, etc. was fantastic. It meant a lot. From the moment we were greeted at the door to the moment we left, we felt valued and supported. Thank you.

The nurse came in promptly and the doctor came in shortly afterwards. Both were nice to work with and had experience working with rabbits which we were very happy about.

Both the nurse, Anita and doctor Pritchard were great! Our rabbit was completely well by the next morning.

DO NOT GO HERE.
My dog was misdiagnosed for a open pyrometra which indicated she needed a emergency spay. That’s false. Took my dog else where and it was a Inguinal Hernia (Groin Area).
This place is MONEY HUNGRY

No words or ratings can ever describe or show how this clinic is the BEST I’ve ever been too. I have to send them a thank you card. Ok so My ferret Bae (Baby) was really sick, I heard her scream like a squeaky toy but with extra volume, which is really unheard of., anyways I took her to this blessed vets office and they took us right in my baby girl had a fever of a 109. And the nurse I was taking care of her Harry up and said I need a doctor over here now they found a mask in her around her intestines and it was really too much they could do but surgery, but they couldn’t do it because she was running a fever and so we had to do it was best for her and her health and her to get her out of pain and they were very compassionate with it all I can say is I really really really really really really appreciate that but I cannot even think of her name worked out because I’m about to cry again, but she is truly God send and I thank her for helping me in my baby girls last moments. Thanks again fr fr Candice Badger they get infinity stars from me and my family *times infinity squared to the infinity power god bless you
VEG ER took great care of my pet, even at 1am, high recommended from friendly staff to dr Marisa that took her time explaining everything to me and caring for my dog as if I she was her own!

Incredible staff and quick care. I really appreciate the up front explanation of care procedures and prices, and never felt pressured into care that wasn’t necessary. Thank you VEG team and Dr. Spurlin for sending us home with our healthy happy pup. We appreciate you guys more than you know!

This place is incompetent at it worst. I try to get detail information on my pets procedure but was  railroad off those same train tracks. I did follow up to find this is the worst place and your be making the worst decision to send your pet. I talk to employee who job is specifically for asking all medical records questions, since all the information is literally accessible to them, but found out their hiring people that not train to do their job title. I was put on hold for over 10 without any detail of why I'm being put on hold, then a random person who was cosplaying as supervisor pop up on conversation unauthorized. I'm already shock that person I was talking to disappear but was alarming that there was no set up to this new person being on phone . This new person put on phone, that says they are a supervisor, which I never ask for, didn't even know anything. The person that threw this suppose to be a supervisor on phone , unauthorized, knew more than this person, they didn't know anything either . Like the blind leading the blind. How are you supposed be person that suppose to be running this place during the shift but empty on information? When I ask questions, this suppose be a supervisor said she has to ask the other supervisor. Huh? I have never heard supervisor say they have ask another supervisor questions that this person posing as a supervisor should know.
This felt like a bad version of slapstick that wasn't funny since this serious patient information that critical on life of my pet.

I will never return back to this place. You cannot trust a place that has employees that not train to perform their job titles. I felt like a person who was going through heart surgery but the doctor who performing the operation, is actually the janitor.
Do not recommend this place. Steer clear of it. The other actual human reviews that wasn't pay for or wasn't bots were right. This place is not fit to take care of your pets. I should have believe the reviews about not trusting this corporate ran place, now I see why. There no heart or care at this place. It all about money and stealing a pay check at this place which is disappointing. There are way better places in DFW that will treat your pet like royalty but this is not that place.
Back leg swell
Compassionate and effective care. Very grateful for Dr. Watson and the VEG team for their prompt help for my dog.

If you have a pet emergency this is where to go!!! I have gone to two different vets done endless online searches and the team tonight finally helped me get to the bottom of what is going on with my fur baby. We rushed here when my dog looked like she was on her last breath. I feel like a weight has been lifted off of me with the answers I got tonight.

We discovered my dog has a problem with her heart valve and she was reading .01 away from the measurement where medicine would no longer be recommended. I do not know how fast or slow her case is progressing but it means the world to me that it was detected in the nick of time so that she can start medicine.

I can’t thank this team enough! Doctor Pritchard was very wise and empathetic!!! I wish she was my regular vet because she is so knowledgeable. The veterinarian assistant whom I believe name started with an A was soooooo patient and kind with me and Princess and answered all my questions clearly!!! The incredible sonogram tech was thorough and super friendly!!! Also,  the other assistant who sat on the floor with Princess when she was trying to make a run for it under the couch to get her blood pressure reading went above and beyond!!

I know me and Princess still have a journey ahead of us but I wholeheartedly believe this team helped us add some more time to that adventure. It is hard to sum into words how invaluable that gift is. Every animal that you all get to treat is fortunate to get to experience the level of care this place provides because they truly give it their all. Thank you VEG ER!!!

Incredible facility, fast triage, and exceptionally kind staff. Being able to stay with my pet during treatment took away so much anxiety. Clear communication, fair and upfront pricing, and top-notch care. Thank you, VEG team!

If I could give this place 100 stars I would. I found myself needing an emergency vet after my dog ate a bag of cherries while I was putting my newborn baby down to bed. From the front office staff, to the doctor, and nurses I was blown away by the kindness and transparency of this office. If you find yourself needing an emergency vet, I couldn’t recommend this office more. Thank you to all the VEG staff who helped both my babies that crazy night.

My dog was having complications from a tplo surgery at 10p that she received from a different clinic. I was able to bring her in & immediately be seen & helped. All the staff is knowledgeable, understanding and the service is excellent. I also like that you stay with your pet the whole time and they include you in the whole process. I’d like to thank Dr Teylor & nurse Hollie. They were great.
VEG is the best! All of the vets and staff are amazing and truly helpful and caring. I always feel like my dog is in good hands in the scariest moments

Review Title: Exceptional Care & Peace of Mind for a Stressed Pet Parent!
I can’t thank the team here enough for how wonderful they were with Daisy. We just recently moved from New York City, and less than a month into settling in, Daisy got sick. Being in a new city and dealing with a sick pet made me feel completely like a fish out of water, but stepping into this clinic immediately put me at ease.
They took such amazing care of Daisy and treated her with so much gentle kindness. Beyond the excellent treatment, they took the time to explain everything to me in layperson's terms so I actually understood what was happening and what to expect. Having a supportive, compassionate team like this when you’re new to the area makes all the difference. Knowing Daisy is in such great hands made me feel completely safe and supported.
If you're looking for a veterinary team that truly cares about both pets and their owners, this is the place to go. Highly recommended!
This clinic was surprisingly terrific! Great staff, knowledgeable people and overall, a very loving experience for a pet parent, when we felt very alarmed.

I was referred to this place by my sister. They provided fast care & treated my baby so gentle despite the circumstances. He was attacked & on edge but the medical team was very understanding & made sure he was comfortable. I trust them with my baby.

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star rating! We hope Gracie is doing well! 

Tiane DeVore, DVM
Medical Director, VEG-Dallas

I must give this ER veterinary clinic the absolute best review! I had to bring in my sick vailed chameleon, the staff was unbelievably caring and helpful and in the moment when I wasn't able to give my chameleon the best care they were able to. I don't have a lot of money but these compassionate people were still able to help. I cannot thank them enough!

They are by far my favorite vet clinic with my favorite vet techs. I’ve brought past pets and my current pet. Each experience I’ve felt as though they listen and are attentive in their actions. Through an extremely difficult time I had to leave my cat there overnight for two days for the first time since I got him in preparation for his surgery at a different clinic. I got a phone call update every shift change and was able to go in anytime to see him. My boy is a quite difficult cat which I’ve seen others be weary of holding or handling him. I saw extreme professionalism with the techs handling a quite large, difficult tom cat. Though it can be quite pricey, the quality and care they have for each animal that comes in especially when it is yours is incredible. Even though he went to another clinic for his surgery, they called and followed up to see how he was doing and told me not to hesitate to have him come in or call at any point should anything occur post-op. I am extremely grateful to every person that works here. Would highly recommend.

My experience was phenomenal and the staff is superb and thanks to their help, it helped lighten the worry on my shoulders. At the very end they did something that stuck with me which was when I was leaving, they all said goodbye to my Cheeto. It was a simple gesture but it shows how much they care and it’s why I fully trust them. Thank you all. 10/10.

This is the best experience I have ever had at a vet clinic. They do an amazing job at triaging, they are quick and efficient. They are also very transparent about pricing and open to explain/discuss. And oh my god, the whole staff is just amazing!!
Dr. Liza Marhanka and Dr. Gabrielle Spurlin were phenomenal, they did a great handoff. They kept me updated at all times, explained everything thoroughly, and treated my little guy like one of their own. I hope we never have an emergency again, but if we do, this is the place we would go back to, no doubts.
Hi Ally! Thank you for your 5-star rating!

We came in with a tough situation and not a clear answer. The staff was incredible throughout the process. They had jobs to do, but were patient and loving to us and to our dog. They communicated extremely well about everything and took the time to let us ask questions. My dog needed surgery and they talked us through what they saw and options. We didn't get news we wanted, but they stayed steady throughout. It takes an incredible person to do what they do, and (I'm sure the Dr. or nurses names I think Dr. Hoffman and Nurse Anita?), but I pray your strength remains, you're doing what you are meant to be doing.

Hopefully you never need to go there, but if your pet ever has a medical emergency, the VEG ER at Knox Henderson in Dallas is unbelievable. Everyone was really kind and caring. They gave great explanations and anticipated and answered all of our questions.

We had to bring our Nala here two days in a row because of an open wound that kept growing. We were scared for Nala and Dr Chabra and staff were so kind and compassionate. I really appreciated the open area and being able to approach while she was doing her procedure and ask questions. One of the rooms was really cold and she provided blankets. There was a lot going on with lots of people with their pets and I really appreciate the care we received.

All ER visits are so stressful but at VEG they really try to make the experience a lot more manageable. The whole staff was very kind and helpful. My fur baby hates vets and is very skittish and they worked around her comfort which I appreciated very much. Dr. Nealy is thorough, informative and kind. Even though they were pretty busy a team member periodically checked in on my pup.

⭐☆☆☆☆
I am beyond heartbroken by my experience at VEG ER. I trusted this hospital with my beloved dog during one of the most frightening moments of our lives, and I left feeling my pet was neglected instead of receiving the attentive care deserved.
Throughout our visit, I felt that my concerns were not taken seriously, communication was poor, and I was left with more questions than answers. Losing a pet is devastating, but it is even more painful when you are left wondering whether more could have been done.
Every pet deserves compassionate, attentive, and timely care, and every owner deserves clear communication about their pet's condition and treatment.
I hope this review encourages the hospital to carefully examine how pets and their families are treated during emergencies. No family should have to leave with the kind of heartbreak and unanswered questions that I have.
I encourage anyone to consider companies that non corporate. This facility performs advocate to go against treating pet right and they don't fully understand to care for animal besides receiving a pay check

I wish they offered classes on how to treat patients and their owners. There are several ER’s around Dallas that could use a lesson from this VEG location.  Being completely transparent is a game changer.  From when we walked in-to when we left, we were able to stay with our pet through the entire process and they didn’t try to hide anything.  Dr. Marisa and her team were fantastic.

Bless yourself, and just go here dont go anywhere else. These team of Angels on Earth are true miracle workers who saved my Kiki and were the most professional and yet also caring, delicate, comforting, amazing healers of the highest order!!! I can never say thanks enough, they saved my baby, a million billion times thank you, eternally grateful 🙏🏼💯✝️
Everyone was very caring and concerned about Leo. Their caring attitude was greatly appreciated.

I brought my three year-old Boston terrier to this ER vet at 11 PM in the evening Friday and they could not have been nicer more attentive and kind in such a very delicate traumatic experience that my Boston terrier, Atticus and I experienced. I found my terrier on the ground in the kitchen having a severe seizure that lasted 14 minutes. He continued to have seizures all evening and that’s when I decided to have him hospitalized the three women physicians were amazing. The team of techs on Friday night were beyond helpful and sweet and loving towards my Boston terrier. I will always recommend this place to  my friends that love their pets and want to have the best care ever!!

I Don’t recall any specific names of the doctors or aides, but this isn’t the first time I’ve brought a pet to VEG and everyone is consistently kind, Informative, and most of all we get excellent care!  Thank you VEG!!
I was so worried about my baby cat I came in sobbing. The vets were so nice and really made me feel taken care of. I want them to know as of today my sweet Moo is okay 💕💕 thank you guys so much …

I brought my sweet boy Zed here during the final days of his life. Although we knew our time together was coming to an end, the care and compassion from this team gave me extra moments with him and the chance to say goodbye. Dr.Fowler and her team of nurses were kind, honest, and supportive through every step, and I’ll always be grateful.

Miette & Corina were amazing!! I felt like my dog really mattered to everyone who helped me tonight. They helped me with something that was so scary to me & made sure that my dog was going to go home with care! I cannot express enough the gratitude I have for how comfortable & welcoming this environment is! Again thank yall so much!

Our puppy was having stomach issues (diarrhea & throwing up). Came here and was seen immediately. Everything was clean and great communication between the main vet and this team.

Dr. Stevie and our nurse were amazing. Answered all our questions super quickly and comprehensively. She even gave us some preventative tips for long-term care for our pup at home.

The nurse told us the facility is open concept, so you’re able to pretty much be next to your pet for almost every procedure, which is so important for keeping them calm in a usually stressful situation.

Also, the cost wasn’t too much more compared with going to the normal vet, which was such a pleasant surprise.

I highly suggest this capable team for anyone who needs speedy, accurate, and thoughtful care!
They were the most caring people in the world with our cat, really phenomenal people, excellent staff all around

I can’t say enough about the team at VEG. From the moment we arrived with my dog, Foxie, we were met with kindness, compassion, and professionalism. The staff was calm, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring, always prioritizing Foxie’s well-being. Their quick actions and expertise truly helped save her life.
They also supported me through a frightening experience, explaining everything clearly and giving me confidence that Foxie was in the best hands. VEG’s exceptional medical care is matched by the empathy and personal attention of every team member.
I’m deeply grateful for the care they gave Foxie and the comfort they gave me. Special thanks to Dr. Matthew Chaney for his calm, thorough care and clear explanations, and to Molly Sullivan for her kindness and for sending me a photo of Foxie while she was receiving oxygen. They made all the difference.

They made the worst experience better. A huge huge thank you to Dr. Nellie , Alberto and the other young lady I can’t recall her name but all were beyond professional and transparent and above all cared for our fur baby. Keep doing what you do, many many thanks!!

I have been to more emergency veterinary hospitals than I ever hoped I would, and until now I had never had a positive experience. VEG completely changed that.
From the moment we walked in, every member of the team treated not only my rescue dog with exceptional compassion and skill, but also recognized how stressful the experience was for me. They were transparent, kind, and communicated every step of the way, making me feel like part of the team in her care instead of a bystander.
Their humanity is just as remarkable as their medical expertise. There is nowhere else I would take my fur babies now in case of an emergency. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of sweet Goldie and her human!
Veg saved my baby Captain’s life. I’m so thankful for Dr. Fowler and her team for taking such good care of him.

My dog has been a patient twice for bloat. It happened a third time, so I called for guidance about bringing him in again. They connected me with Dr. Fowler, which I didn’t expect them to do, who advised me to watch him instead of bringing him in. Saved me thousands of dollars. I am so grateful and Marvin ended up being fine. Another ER might have told me to rush him there. Thank you. VEG is amazing and honest and fair. Trust your pets with them.

Dr. Marhanka and Nurse Lesley (i think that was her name. She had a lip ring) were great and I really appreciate how they advised me on my dogs nasal issue and the best treatment for him. Ollie is already showing improvements. Thank you!

VEG was absolutely amazing and incredibly compassionate during one of the hardest moments I've experienced. My dog had been hit by a car, and I was completely overwhelmed, but the entire team helped me through the process with so much care and kindness.

The nurse who cared for us was exceptional. She was comforting, patient, understanding, and incredibly gentle with both my dog and my emotions. She took the time to thoroughly explain everything and answered every question I had in a way that made me feel informed and supported. I wish I had gotten her name because she truly made such a difficult experience a little easier.

I hope I never have another emergency, but if I do, I wouldn't hesitate to come back to VEG. They have an outstanding team, and I'm so grateful for the compassion and care they showed us when we needed it most. Gilbert and I left with a smile!

This vet is pricey, but has amazing people working there. They got to my Kuzco quickly. He was taken care. They kept us apart of the whole process and have options for payments. I am really appreciative of this ER being available tonight. I highly recommend them.
Very kind and attentive. Both Dr Watson and Misty’s were comprehensive with our cat. It was a good experience considering we were dealing with an injured cat.  Thanks for your help!

I can never recommend this place enough. The staff is incredible and made us feel right at home while we were waiting for care for our dog. Two beds were made, pillows and blankets, and staff tending to the dogs throughout the night. They will forever be my go-to for all emergency care.
Very caring and friendly people  i I felt very comfortable with having my baby under their care

There are simply not enough words to express my gratitude to the incredible team at VEG ER for Pets in Dallas. They truly saved my sweet dog, Poppy’s, life, and I will be forever grateful.

From the moment we walked through the doors, every person we encountered treated Poppy—and me—with compassion, urgency, and genuine kindness. During one of the most terrifying experiences of my life, Dr. Marhanka, Dr. Nealy, Dr. Huffman, Dr. Peter, and Dr. Chaney provided exceptional medical care while taking the time to explain everything in a way I could understand. They kept me informed throughout Poppy’s treatment, answered every question with patience, and never made me feel alone in the process.

I also want to recognize Molly, AJ, Brittany, Mahogany, and Haley for the outstanding care, kindness, and compassion they showed us. Every member of the team worked together seamlessly, and it was clear that Poppy wasn’t just another patient—she was treated as if she were their own.

One of the things that sets VEG apart is their commitment to keeping pet parents involved. Being able to stay with Poppy while she was receiving care and being kept informed every step of the way brought comfort during an incredibly frightening time.

Because of the expertise, dedication, and compassion of this remarkable team, Poppy is alive today. That is a gift my family can never repay.

Thank you, Dr. Marhanka, Dr. Nealy, Dr. Huffman, Dr. Peter, and Dr. Chaney and the entire VEG Dallas team, for giving us more time with our beloved girl. You didn’t just save Poppy’s life—you gave our family hope during our darkest moment. We will never forget what you did for us, and I recommend VEG Dallas without the slightest hesitation to anyone whose pet needs emergency care.

Thank you for everything y'all did for my cat Stirfry. I thought for sure it would be my last day with her, but you've given us more time together, and I'll treasure however long we have left. She's resting easy at home now. The staff was very kind and compassionate, allowing me time, explaining my options, and answering any questions I had. I'm so thankful an open concept ER like this exists, and that I was able to stay by her side through her operation and recovery. Thank you Dr. C and Sarah--I can't quite remember your full surname (Corbeu? I'm sorry😭), for walking me through Stirfry's procedure and letting me watch. Nerve-wracking, but their calm demeanor and expertise were doubly reassuring. And thank you Dr. Marisa and Brenna for looking after us throughout the night. Very warm and compassionate people. Your pets are in great hands here.
Recommend 100% they care about your ANIMAL not the money!! They are so good at what they do by nurse Brenna was amazing at assisting me in payment form to meet my needs!! Love the service 10/10🫶🏻 …

I arrived with my dog, Gordo, who was very sick. Everyone was very kind. The nurse was especially attentive, and since I don't speak English, she helped me a lot with the translation. I had my dog ​​tested to confirm if it was parvovirus, and he tested positive. I was very sad; it wasn't good news. But the doctor gave me several treatment options, and I chose the cheapest one because we are a low-income family. Our intention was to save our dog, but the doctor gave me the treatment, and I did exactly as she said. The nurses showed me how to administer it, and that was key because my dog ​​has been healthy for six days now and is already eating and drinking water on his own and playing with his siblings. Even though I didn't have the full amount to pay, they accepted what I had at the time without any excuses. I am very grateful to everyone. My dog ​​is doing well; now he just needs to regain the weight he lost. Thank you for everything. Greetings from Gordo.

Always amazing.  Always show compassion and care.  They never make you feel your pet's reason for being there is any less urgent or important than anyone else in there.  Every pet is just as urgent as the next.  Very caring.

There’s really nothing I can say that will accurately express my gratitude I have for the staff at VEG.
I cannot say enough good things about this emergency veterinary hospital and the incredible team(s) who cared for my dog.

From the moment we walked through the doors back in April, every staff member treated both my dog and me with kindness, compassion, and professionalism. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered every question I had, and made sure I felt informed and supported throughout his care. Their knowledge, communication, and bedside manner were truly exceptional.

Most importantly, when the time came for me to make the heartbreaking decision to let my sweet baby go, they treated us with so much dignity and compassion. I never felt rushed or dismissed. They listened to my concerns, honored my wishes, and helped me feel confident that I was making the most loving decision for him. During one of the hardest moments of my life, they made me feel heard, supported, and cared for.

I will always be grateful for the kindness they showed my dog during his final moments and for the comfort they provided me in the days that followed. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my baby and for helping him cross the rainbow bridge with peace, love, and dignity. Your compassion will never be forgotten.
Nothing fell short of any standards, everyone was great and the whole process was amazing!

Incredible staff and incredible service. My dog suddenly became very ill, we took him to another emergency vet and his regular vet. Neither could figure out what was wrong with him, they just blamed it on gas. Our dogs eyes became very dilated, he became lethargic and didn’t want to be touched so we decided to go to Veg Er.
They listened to every symptom he had, immediately took his vitals, put him on fluids, got a urine sample, did x rays, etc.
The doctor came out she said he needed to be hospitalized, which I knew all along. They called me the next morning and said he had a rare parasite and possibly addison’s disease. After a couple days of his medication he’s stating to be back to himself. I’m so grateful I brought him here because I don’t think he would have lived otherwise.
They also did an amazing job at answering any question or concern I had.

The team here was absolutely incredible! Focused on our pup, then turned their focus to us. We were able to remain at our boys side from beginning to end. We were treated like royalty! What looked like a doomed situation became one of the best experiences I have ever had. Love these guys! Superb business model! Absolutely blown away!

We have been here many, many times, and everyone is always so amazing 👏 but I have to say, this trip was above and well beyond the exceptional care we always recieve!

I want to say our duration at the hospital was about 7 hours this past Sunday.

Of course my daughter and I blew out the door and forgot a charger, and what 8 yo could sit in a vet office for 7 hours without her tablet and phone?  They were happy to charge our devices for us, keeping my daughter entertained, and even gave her a blanket once it got chilly!

Cody is ALWAYS great.   I know we are in great hands every time we have him!  He is so attentive and so compassionate.  I just love having him on our team he is amazing!

We had Dr. Crocker, and let me say, this woman is a FANTASTIC doctor!  She was fabulous from start to finish.  Listened to my concerns, walked me through different options and made sure I truly understood everything.

The Dog we brought in is sweet as can be but can definitely get fussy when it comes to needles and such, but they understood her needs and allowed me to help them help her be comfortable with what they were doing and just made me feel so much better about the whole ordeal for her, without traumatizing her!  And no one got bit which is always a HUGE PLUS 😆

I was very comfortable with them.  My daughter was comfortable for the duration of the time we were there, and most importantly, they made sure our Katie girl was comfortable and taken care of!

Thank y'all for always being so great.

There was so much going on.  So many animals, so much "chaos" but I watched in amazment as the ENTIRE STAFF worked together, never missing a beat, just getting things done - and every animal taken care of!  Never a sign of distress from any of them.  Cool, calm and collected the entire time!

You all truly have a wonderful team!
Angelina S. and the doctor were so sweet, helpful and patient.

We had a scary accident occur with our 11 month old puppy.  The entire staff at VEG was incredible — from immediate triage to a careful assessment and eventually medication, the VEG experience far exceeded my expectations. VEG is the only place to take your pet for emergency care.
I recommend this ER to anyone who is having an emergency with their animal the ENTIRE STAFF is heaven sent thank you so much to everyone there……
The staff, techs and Dr Petre took great care of my Doxie.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Fowler, Sheila, and the entire VEG ER team for the exceptional care they provided to my dog.

Dr. Fowler was kind, patient, and compassionate. She thoroughly explained the diagnostic tests and helped me understand my dog's condition in a clear, supportive, and empathetic manner, enabling me to make the best decision for her well-being. My senior dog was receiving palliative care for lung cancer, and after several weeks of declining health, her ability to breathe worsened significantly on Saturday night, prompting a visit to VEG ER.

When the time came to make the difficult decision to let her go, Dr. Fowler and the entire team provided both medical expertise and genuine compassion.

Every member of the staff was caring, patient, and respectful, giving me the time, space, and information I needed to make an incredibly difficult decision in my dog's best interest. They took wonderful care of my dog and showed the same kindness and concern for me throughout the process.

Being able to stay with my dog throughout the entire visit meant so much to me and brought great comfort during a heartbreaking time.

I am deeply grateful for the care, dignity, and compassion shown to both my dog and me. I highly recommend VEG ER to anyone seeking exceptional emergency veterinary care for their pet.
From triage to dismissal the staff and Doctors and techs were fantastic. The kept us well informed and took amazing care of our puppy.  Can't recommend this urgent care for pets more highly

This place is the greatest! Everyone, the doctors, vet techs and phone operators, are terrific. I hope your pet doesn’t have a situation where you need their service, but if you do you will be glad you went there. They are thorough and caring. Most of all you can stay with your pet while they work. Blood draws were the best I’ve seen,  no limping or favoring the leg, as I have seen other times and places. Open 24/7 you can always call to check on your pet if they need to stay; also if they need to stay you are welcome to come visit any time.

I have no words on how reassured and calm the VEG team made us feel, they were all Rockstars and so kind and patient with us being a bit scattered and worried over our pet.

Shout out to the ENTIRE staff tonight! They were so amazing and I loved them! HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend!

So nice, so sweet, and so helpful. I love my dog, and everybody in this hospital has a passion for what they do, it shows. Thank you for a wonderful experience. My pup was back to his normal self in no time. 💙 …

Thank you for your kind rating! We're truly grateful to hear that you had a wonderful experience with us. Your satisfaction inspires us to continue serving others with care.

Stacie English
VEG Dallas, Hospital Manager

We greatly appreciate Dr. Rogers for her quick assessment and Dr. Spurling for completing Luna’s surgery and saving her life. And so grateful to Angelica and the rest of the staff for treating Luna with so much kindness and care. Highly recommended this ER!
Very accessible staff, competitive price. Very caring and friendly.

They were all truly great. Every single person inspired confidence and reassurance. But Dr Crocker was particularly important to me. She was very approachable. I had absolute confidence in her. She explained things. She gave me the impression we could handle anything. I felt like I had the A Team who also had a lot of heart on the case. This was not just a business transaction. They all treated us- all of us- like people. They all seemed like they had great chemistry too. Think they should run the world.

I never imagined that I would ever end up in a pet ER, but I am so grateful that Veg is in my neighborhood, after a frightening experience with my new puppy. Dr. Crocker was amazing and made me feel so at ease. I trusted her knowledge and opinion regarding the situation. Loved her!!! What a great concept and truly needed business for our neighborhood! Also, the receptionist and the rest of the staff was so kind, helpful, and seemed to really care. So thankful for everyone that I encountered during my visit. Kudos to the entire team!!!!

Seeing women, YES WOMEN, doing such amazing work like this had me in awe. I LOVE TO SEE THIS GOING ON!! Just by walking in and going straight to the back, I gave a big plus right there!! The team of nurses and doctors are super nice and helpful. They did everything to make sure my boy was calm and my kids and I were ok. They continuously checked on us and Dr. Fowler was so patient, warm and loving.

I wish I could compliment every woman on this team of nurses and doctors. Dr. Fowler took such great care of my boy and family. We love you ladies and we thank you all deeply.

We went in with a poisoned puppy late Friday night. We called ahead and were immediately seen.

The vet techs were very sweet in helping us. Mahogany helped us the most frequently.
The whole staff and Dr. Crocker were amazing! They were all so kind and caring. 10/10 would recommend and will definitely be back if needed. So thankful I found them!

Star at the front desk was kind, and attentive. Sierra provided all the vitals and care for my cat and she was very kind and informative throughout everything. Dr. Blayne Huffman was just as sweet as could be and seemed to pay attention to my cat despite it being a full house. Overall it was a positive experience. As worried as I was about my fur baby going in, I left feeling so much better  after the care we received! To be honest, everyone one staff was busy yet they approached everyone & their pets graciously and expeditiously - I’m sure my cat would’ve been well taken care of by anyone there!
We observed the entire staff in the treatment area and everyone was engaged and very kind and sweet to the animals they were treating.

Incredibly professional and friendly staff!. They took care of our furry baby perfectly & let us stayed with then in every step. They make us feel calmer during the  anxious experience . Thank you all!.
I only wish they had regular followers up clinics!

VEG ER saved my pug Pippin's life. We showed up around 2 in the morning on Sunday after Pip had suddenly woken up, vomited, and gone limp. I called VEG while we were en route, and by the time we walked through their doors Dr. Nealy and the entire night shift was waiting for us. They worked tirelessly for HOURS to make sure Pippin survived. He went from "stage 3 critical care" to "stable monitoring" in seven hours, all thanks to their dedication and hard work. The day shift with Dr. Fowler took over seamlessly as well, letting me stay with Pippin the whole day, snuggling on the floor in front of his medical crate.
I wouldn't have a dog today if VEG hadn't taken such astronomically good care of Pip. I could cry from gratitude for saving my boy.

I took my mother's pomeranian in for rat poisoning and we were there total about 1hr 1/2. I am super happy & pleased with their service and how prompt they were with attending us they saved Josey's life ❤️ thank you so much! HIGHLY RECOMMEND

I absolutely love this ER clinic!! The doctor and the vet assistants are extremely kind, and they also work with your budget. My fur baby is growing up beautifully because of them. Thank you so much! ♡

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're truly pleased to hear that you had a positive experience with us. Your feedback inspires us to continuously improve and strive for even better service in the future.

First time Vet ER visit for us for our 7 month old puppy. Called at 2 am explaining what was going on and they immediately connected me with the doctor who said to come in. Highly recommend this location if you ever have to come in.

My dog's name is Zeus. He arrived with a very serious bite from a German Shepherd. I think it's the best thing that ever happened to my dog ​​to come into their care.
